ELESIS-BELDER_KNIGHT_EMBLEM.title: Belder Knight Emblem
ELESIS-BELDER_KNIGHT_EMBLEM.description:
At the start of each combat, gain 2 [blue]Chivalry[/blue].
Gains experience after each map node.
At 15 experience, Elesis chooses a specialization for the rest of the run.
ELESIS-BELDER_KNIGHT_EMBLEM.flavor: A knightly emblem from Belder, carried as proof of resolve.
